notes: Creativity: the local culture promotion in E4 (454 employees at cultural events) is too vague to count as an arts activity, so it was scored for Community only; the internal 'Cybersecurity Visual Creation Awards' is an employee risk-awareness contest and was not counted. Entrepreneurship: plans to reach 'medium and small customers, such as regional data centers' are planned serving only; MemoLead is a joint venture (trap). Board diversity targets (1/4, then 1/3 female directors) are plans and were not scored. Supplier audits found 94 non-conformances, all remediated, but these are not described as rights violations found by an outside body; the report states 0 sexual harassment cases and 0 human rights violations in 2025.
